mechanism: Both drugs exhibit CNS depressant effects and may increase risk of extrapyramidal symptoms through dopaminergic and serotonergic pathway modulation; buspirone is metabolized via CYP3A4 which fluphenazine may inhibit to a minor degree.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression, sedation, and extrapyramidal side effects; use lowest effective doses and adjust based on clinical response and tolerability.
